[MITM]
hostname = richmanrules.ksedt.com, api.jxedt.com, richmanapi.jxedt.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/richmanrules\.ksedt\.com\/intellectWaterfall(Bidding)?\/find/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/richmanapi\.jxedt\.com\/api\/(ad|adplus|banadplus)\//i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.jxedt\.com\/ad\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.jxedt\.com\/jump\/EMiCcDNp/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/richmanmain\.jxedt\.com\/advertisement\/fallback/i then reject_img(200)
